empty.title: No site users yet
empty.description: Invite people by email, or let a sign-in provider create accounts for your organisation's domain.

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.name: Name (optional)
invite.sent: The invitation is on its way to {{email}}.
invite.linkHint: If it does not arrive, send them this link yourself. It works once, for a limited time.

membership.title: Groups of {{name}}
membership.noGroups: There are no groups yet. Create them on the Groups tab.
membership.hint: A change reaches the person's open session within minutes, when their sign-in is next refreshed.

groups.intro: Groups are how you give access to many people at once: in site rules and in roles.
groups.confirmDelete: Delete the group {{name}}? Its members stay, but lose whatever the group gave them. A site rule that only admits this group admits nobody after this.

empty.title: No groups yet
empty.description: Create groups like Staff or Partners, then use them in site rules and roles.

sites.intro: Rules apply in order: the first one whose path covers a page decides who may see it. A page no rule covers is public. /portal covers /portal and everything under it.
sites.noHosts: This site has no domain yet, so its rules apply nowhere.
sites.noRules: No rules: every page of this site is public.
sites.noGroups: Create groups first, on the Users screen.

spa.notice: This site is a single-page app. Its rules guard pages loaded directly; moving between pages inside the app never reaches them. Protect the data those pages read under API access.
spa.assets: People let in by {{paths}} can't load the app itself: its code under /assets is covered by a stricter rule, so they'd see a blank page.

empty.title: No sites yet
empty.description: Create a site and give it a domain; then you can decide which of its pages need signing in.

api.intro: Who may call each plugin's site API, /api/…: the data behind your pages, whichever page or app asks. This is what protects a single-page app, whose own navigation never meets the site rules. An instance set to permission needs a role holding its read or write permission.
api.empty: No plugins with a site API are enabled.

roles.intro: A role is a set of permissions on your apps and APIs. Give it to groups or to single users.
roles.confirmDelete: Delete the role {{name}}? Everyone holding it loses its permissions on their next request.
roles.name: Name
roles.noResources: No enabled plugin offers anything to gate yet. You can still type permission keys below.

empty.title: No roles yet
empty.description: Roles decide what signed-in users may do with your apps' tables, flows and APIs.

signIn.notReady: Sign-in to your sites is not configured on this platform yet, so nobody can sign in. Your settings are kept and take effect once it is.
signIn.passwordsHint: Invited people set a password. Turn it off to allow only the providers below.
signIn.noHosts: None of your sites has a verified domain yet, so there is nowhere to sign in.
signIn.confirmDelete: Remove {{name}}? People who only sign in with it lose their way in.
signIn.none: None yet. Add Google Workspace, Microsoft Entra ID, any OpenID Connect provider, or DCMS accounts.
signIn.callback: Redirect URI to register at the provider
signIn.entraHint: One directory. common, organizations and consumers are refused: they would let any directory vouch for an email.
signIn.hostedDomainHint: Only accounts of this Google Workspace domain may sign in.
signIn.secretKept: A secret is stored. Leave this empty to keep it; it is never shown again.
signIn.dcmsHint: People sign in with their DCMS account, which is linked to their own account here. It never becomes an admin account.
